source.title: Call for Applicants - WAT Leader (May 2022)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Archive Team (WAT) Leader.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 4 - 6 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:
 
* Good communication
* Goal-oriented
* Project management experience
* Proactive

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **May 19th, 2022, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
 
1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WAT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2022.12](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.12%20-%20Archive%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 档案团队负责人（2022 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命新一届档案团队（WAT）负责人。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 4–6 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

* 善于沟通。
* 做事目标明确。
* 有项目管理经验。
* 积极主动。

申请截止时间为 **2022 年 5 月 19 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
3. 担任 WCA 档案团队负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WAT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.12](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.12%20-%20Archive%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
